problem_statement: When a radio or TREL URL is parsed, its query parameters are consumed by the interfaces that look them up by name. The URL parser should be able to determine whether any query parameter was never consumed and, if so, report the name of the first unused parameter so the application can fail at start-up. Currently there is no way to check whether all query parameters were consumed: a URL that contains a parameter no component recognizes is silently accepted and no error is raised. The URL type must support querying whether every parameter was used and obtaining the name of the first unused one.
